spans.text: At times it can feel like everyone else is getting the exhibition, the grant, the residency, or the attention you’ve been working toward. Building an art career is rarely a straight line, rather it’s a process of showing up, continuing to make work that matters to you, and staying connected to opportunities that can move your practice forward. Every application you submit, every new resource you discover, and every connection you make adds another piece to the foundation you’re building.
